purpose: Cristian asked for a harsh cut of tests and CI steps that are not needed, so PR CI takes about 3 minutes with nothing real lost.
mechanism: Deleted 17 tests and merged 6 overlapping test functions into 3; each commit message names what still guards each. CI (.github/workflows/verify.yml): fault tests run on push to main, nightly at 07:00 UTC and workflow_dispatch, not on pull_request, in 3 duration-balanced groups; coverage is merged from the 4 shards and the browser job and the floor checked once; scripts/check_ci_results.py is removed; the final job is named verify, needs every job, runs unless cancelled, fails if any needed job failed or was cancelled, then checks coverage. .test_durations is refreshed from a full run of 942 tests. Local ./verify.sh and ./verify.sh --fault are unchanged.
decisions: Fault tests leave PRs because they set the PR wall time; an outage-handling bug now surfaces on main or nightly instead. Tests that turned out to be the only guard of something were kept. Service images are not cached: saving and loading them takes as long as pulling them.
readers: docs/operations.md and README.md: people running Docket's checks. Comments in .github/workflows/verify.yml: the next maintainer.
